name: nf-gst
description: Classify Norfolk Island transactions under Australian GST territorial, registration, export and input-credit rules for 2026. Use for Norfolk GST, mainland sales, voluntary registration, goods exported to the island, tax invoices, mixed business use and credit timing questions. Covers indirect tax zone definitions, current and projected turnover, exact threshold boundaries, supplier and recipient export conditions, and fictional standard-rate computations. Includes primary legislation and regulations. This source-cited reference requires the universal and VAT workflow bases and holds special schemes, actual return preparation and missing legal or transaction conditions; it is not a complete country pack.
